summary.en: Resize preserves valid edits of imported plans without micro-crossings on the fixed coordinate.
summary.ru: Resize сохраняет допустимое изменение импортированного плана без микропересечений на неподвижной координате.

rationale: Model11 Resize recovered both numeric ordinates after one changed; preserve unchanged exact legacy ordinates to avoid new unsplit crossings against fixed neighbours.
